_comment: Copy to tools/confidential-patterns.json (gitignored) and fill in the real
entries. The specific designators live outside version control on purpose:
a published list of what must never be named is itself a disclosure of what
confidential material exists. The gate still works for anyone who clones —
they just supply their own list.
block: patterns that are a compliance incident on their own (product
designators that appear only in confidential material).
warn:  patterns that need a human look (bare vendor names, host identity).
Do NOT add publicly documented NVIDIA product names (A100, H20, H100, H200,
B200, GB200, ...) to either list. They are public facts and this project
depends on naming them precisely to keep results comparable.
